query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, gather 'round, ye brave souls! 🏴‍☠️

Listen up, every last one of ye, for yer captain speaks! We didn't brave these treacherous seas, dodge the navy's cannons, and weather the fiercest of storms just to sail home empty-handed, did we?! **NAY!**

Out there, beyond that horizon, lies a treasure so grand, so magnificent, that legends tremble at the mere whisper of its name! Gold doubloons piled high as the masts! Jewels that shimmer brighter than the stars that guide our ship! Riches enough to make every king and queen on land burn green with envy!

I know the journey has been long. I know yer bones ache and yer spirits waver. But hear me now — **the greatest pirates in history were not the ones who turned back.** They were the ones who pressed ON, through doubt, through darkness, through doubt again — and came out the other side LEGENDS!

Every map has an X, and that X belongs to **US!** Not to the faint of heart, not to those who cower in port — but to this crew, THIS ship, and THIS captain!

So pick up yer shovels, sharpen yer cutlasses, and let fire burn in yer hearts! We sail hard, we dig deep, and we claim what fate has set aside for the bold and the daring!

**For glory! For gold! For the crew of this ship!** ⚓

Now MOVE, ye magnificent rogues, before the tide turns against us! ARRR! 🦜
